name: The Shade of Elura
label: Quest
description: At Auberdine, Elura's shade guards a sunken ship and its Elunite ore. Elanaria sends young night elf warriors into the waters to lay the captain to rest…

clips.title: The story
paras: At Auberdine, Elura's shade guards a sunken ship and its Elunite ore. Elanaria sends young night elf warriors into the waters to lay the captain to rest and recover her medallion and ore for a weapon forged by Smith Mathiel.

Long ago, a ship carrying rare Elunite ore struck jagged coastal rocks near the Auberdine lighthouse and sank. The captain, Elura, cursed her own soul in despair and out of unwavering duty. Bound to the wreck beneath the waves, her shade guards the lost cargo from anyone who would disturb it.

Elanaria sends young night elf warriors into Darkshore's surf to defeat Elura, recover her medallion, and salvage the ore. They need both the medallion and ore to put the captain to rest and bring the metal to Smith Mathiel's forge. The work tests their martial skill and respect for the fallen, and provides the ore for a crafted weapon.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have learned much, friend. Now we will craft you a weapon. A warrior's weapon.
To do this, you must travel to Darkshore.
Long ago a ship crashed upon the rocks near the Auberdine lighthouse, scattering many crates of elunite ore along the ocean floor.

First, you must defeat the elunite's guardian, the Shade of Elura. Once the ship's captain, she cursed herself to roam the deeps and protect her shipment for all time. Defeat her, gain her medallion, and gather the crates of lost Elunite.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you defeated the Shade of Elura, friend? And do you have the lost elunite ore?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have given the Shade of Elura much deserved peace, and we will use the gathered elunite to make a fine weapon for you.
